intro: The Sealed Note to Watcher Backus is a confidential dispatch written by master cheese merchant and informant Elling Trias. Addressed to a member of the Night Watch patrolling the road outside Darkshire, it calls in a personal favor to gather intelligence on Defias activity in Duskwood.

p: When the initial leads on the missing diplomat stall in Stormwind, cheese monger Elling Trias decides to bypass his stubborn informant Jorgen and utilize his own private network instead. He pens this wax-sealed missive to Watcher Backus, a Night Watch guard stationed in Duskwood. Trias sends an adventurer south through the gloomy forest to deliver it by hand, using his longstanding rapport with Backus to secure any reports of Defias presence wandering near Darkshire.
